tools.name: Blend
tools.positioning: The borrower-facing front end a bank puts in front of its origination system.
tools.description: Blend provides digital application experiences for mortgage, home equity and consumer lending: guided borrower application, automated asset, income and employment verification, document collection, status tracking and loan officer tooling, integrated into the lender's origination system.
tools.real_estate_use: The failure point in mortgage is the borrower experience: a form that asks for two years of bank statements as PDFs loses applicants to a competitor. Blend replaces that with direct connections to payroll and bank data, so verification happens in the application instead of three weeks later, and the loan officer sees a complete file sooner.
features: Guided digital mortgage and home equity applications
Automated asset, income and employment verification
Document collection with borrower status tracking
Loan officer workspace and pipeline visibility
Integration with origination systems and pricing engines
Configurable workflows per lender product

use_cases.job: Reduce application abandonment with verified data instead of document uploads
Give borrowers a live status view instead of a phone call for every update

tools.name: Créditéo
tools.positioning: Cloud software for French credit intermediaries: build a mortgage file and its simulations, follow the lenders, invoice the fee.
tools.description: Créditéo is a French publisher of web applications for regulated credit intermediaries, real estate agents and notaries. Its platform centralises prospect and client files, runs configurable financing simulations, and tracks the lenders and parties attached to each case in a single dashboard. It issues fee invoices, bank commission invoices and off-case invoices in line with the French billing rules that took effect in January 2018, and reports production by branch, broker, partner, stage and period. Rights management and configurable case stages let a network reproduce its own process. The editor states more than 20,000 users.
tools.real_estate_use: A broker's day is a queue of half-complete files, each waiting on a document or a lender's answer. Créditéo is the desk where that queue is ordered: configurable stages say where each case stands, task lists and notifications say who owes what, and the simulator turns an affordability question into a fully-formed loan application in a single sitting. Its invoicing module matters more than it sounds — French intermediary fees can only be billed once the funds are released, so a broker needs the tool to know the difference between a fee earned and a commission owed by the bank. Web calculators and pre-filling contact forms embed on the broker's own site, so an enquiry arrives as a started file instead of an e-mail.
features: Centralised prospect and client files with configurable case stages and task lists
Financing simulator that assembles the loan application from the simulation
Lender and party dashboard per case
Fee, bank commission and off-case invoicing with payment tracking
Production statistics by branch, broker, partner, stage and period
Embeddable web calculators and pre-filling contact forms for the broker's site

use_cases.job: Assemble a complete mortgage application and its simulations in one sitting, then follow it to release of funds
Invoice fees and bank commissions from the case file and reconcile what has actually been paid

tools.name: Eloa
tools.positioning: French origination platform for credit intermediaries: simulate a mortgage, assemble the borrower file, apply each bank convention, invoice the commission.
tools.description: Eloa publishes eCredits, a configurable platform for regulated credit intermediaries in France, alongside eImmo for rental and renovation financing and eMobilite for vehicle dealers. eCredits covers mortgage, consumer, professional and debt consolidation lending. Its calculation engine produces amortising, zero-interest, interest-only, bridge, stepped and smoothed loan scenarios, and applies the rate grids and document requirements the broker has configured for each partner bank. It also handles commission, invoicing and activity reporting, and offers a broker website module. The editor states more than 20,000 professionals use it.
tools.real_estate_use: A French mortgage broker is an IOBSP: the file it assembles has to satisfy both the borrower and a bank whose rate grid, document list and commission terms differ from every other bank's. Eloa is where that file lives from the first simulation to the accepted offer. The broker qualifies affordability with the simulators, which create the case and carry the data forward instead of being re-keyed, then compares scenarios across the banks configured in its own conventions. Because commissioning and invoicing sit in the same tool, a network can see per-branch and per-broker production without exporting anything. Agencies and developers meet it from the other side, as the financing partner's system that tells them whether a buyer is financeable.
features: Mortgage simulators covering amortising, zero-interest, interest-only, bridge, stepped and smoothed loans
Bank conventions configured per network or branch: rate grids, required documents, invoicing, commission
Automatic pre-qualification that opens the case file from the simulation without re-keying
Commission, invoicing and payment tracking for brokers and IOBSP agents
Configurable case stages, user rights and document completeness rules
Broker website module and embeddable calculators

use_cases.job: Compare financing scenarios across partner banks for one borrower and produce the funding plan the client signs
Track production and commission per branch and per broker without leaving the origination tool

capabilities: Assistant marketed as IA Courtier for speeding up loan file processing

tools.name: Encompass
tools.positioning: The loan origination system a large share of US mortgages are actually manufactured in.
tools.description: Encompass is a loan origination system covering the mortgage lifecycle: application intake, processing, underwriting, closing document generation, compliance testing and delivery to investors, with a configuration and partner ecosystem around it.
tools.real_estate_use: A residential mortgage is a regulated manufacturing process — disclosure timing, fee tolerance, appraisal ordering, TRID compliance — where a missed deadline is a legal defect, not an inconvenience. Encompass encodes those rules in the workflow, which is why it sits at the centre of most lender operations and why the whole vendor ecosystem integrates with it.
features: End-to-end loan origination workflow from application to funding
Automated compliance testing including TRID and disclosure timing
Closing document generation and e-signature
Product and pricing engine integration
Investor delivery and secondary market handoff
Extensive partner integration marketplace

use_cases.job: Manufacture a compliant residential loan file from application to funding
Deliver closed loans to investors without re-keying the file

tools.name: Floify
tools.positioning: Document collection and borrower communication for the individual loan originator, not the enterprise.
tools.description: Floify is a mortgage point-of-sale and document portal: borrower application intake, secure document collection with automated chasing, milestone notifications to all parties, and loan officer pipeline tools, sold at a price an individual originator can carry.
tools.real_estate_use: Most of a loan officer's day is chasing paperwork and telling agents where the file stands. Floify automates both — it requests missing documents until they arrive, and notifies the borrower and both agents at each milestone. For a small brokerage or an independent originator it replaces the enterprise point-of-sale they cannot buy.
features: Borrower document portal with automated follow-up requests
Loan application intake and 1003 form handling
Milestone notifications to borrower, agents and partners
Loan officer pipeline and task management
E-signature and secure document storage
Integration with origination systems and credit providers

use_cases.job: Stop chasing borrower documents manually on every file
See loan milestone status without calling the loan officer
